descriptionChirho: A portable shelter made of cloth or skins used as a dwelling, covering all singular and plural inflections, construct chains, and pronominal suffixes; target languages uniformly render 'tent' (Arabic خَيْمَة/خِيَام, Korean 장막, Swahili hema/mahema, Hindi तम्बू, Spanish tienda) whether the referent is a personal dwelling, a military camp tent, or the sacred Tabernacle (אֹהֶל מוֹעֵד).

A single occurrence tagged Art|Adv where the token does not translate as 'tent' in any target language; Arabic renders هَذِهِ ('these'), Swahili renders nyumba-ya ('house of'), and English/Spanish bracket alternatives, indicating a parsing or textual-variant anomaly rather than a genuine sense of אֹהֶל.
